latest_release.name: V4.12.0 Tigrex 🐅
latest_release.body:
MiaoYan V4.12.0 Tigrex 🐅

A native Markdown editor for engineers.

Changelog

  1. Mac: Tables line up in columns with quieter pipes, and a Table menu adds and removes rows and columns
  2. Mac: Version history shows how many lines each version changed and highlights what it changed
  3. Mac: A long list item wraps under its own words instead of under the dash
  4. Mac: In split view the preview reaches the end together with the editor, even when a note ends in images or tables
  5. Mac: Going into and out of the preview keeps the line you were on, and leaving a presentation or PPT brings back the columns it hid
  6. Mac: Cleaning unused attachments is safer: files used by notes in subfolders or the Trash, notes still only in iCloud, and files you just added are never removed
  7. Mac: Command-Z outside the editor undoes the note on screen, pressing Replace again no longer replaces text it just wrote, and the slash templates write their placeholders in your interface language
  8. Mac: YouTube videos play right in the preview and in exported HTML
  9. Mac: Mermaid diagrams in Magic PPT draw properly instead of showing a syntax error, and its PDF export waits for every diagram before printing
  10. Mac: Formulas and code in mind maps show properly, a map sits centred in an exported PDF, and nothing loads from the network
  11. Mac: Typing below a code block in a very long note no longer slows down
  12. Tab and Return move between cells as you edit a table
  13. Pins follow your notes to your other devices through iCloud
  14. The preview and slides show chemistry formulas, \( \) and \[ \] read as math in a note without $, and a wide formula scrolls sideways
  15. Links written for GitHub reach their heading, and pie charts use eight soft colours so touching slices never match
  16. Note list dates follow your system's region and 12 or 24-hour clock
  17. Notes can hold videos and files: videos play in the preview and in PPT, other files show as links that open in their own app, dragged in on Mac or picked from Photos, the camera or Files on iPhone and iPad, and they move along with the note
  18. iPhone and iPad: Share a web page or text from Safari or any app to MiaoYan, and it becomes a note
  19. iPhone and iPad: Settings lets you choose whether a single Return starts a new line, and iPhone turns to landscape for reading and editing
  20. iPhone and iPad: An insert bar above the keyboard adds to-dos, lists, links and attachments without remembering Markdown marks
  21. iPhone and iPad: A new note saves itself once it has a title, and the top buttons and More menus follow the system's layout, with common actions first and Delete last

更新日志

  1. Mac：表格按列对齐显示，竖线淡下去，表格菜单可以增删行和列
  2. Mac：版本历史显示每个版本改了几行，并把这一版改动的地方标出来
  3. Mac：很长的列表项换行后和自己的文字对齐，不再缩到短横下面
  4. Mac：分栏时预览跟着编辑器一起滚到底，笔记以图片或表格结尾时也能看到最后
  5. Mac：进出预览都停在刚才那一行，退出演示或 PPT 后收起的栏会回来
  6. Mac：清理未使用的附件更稳妥，子文件夹和废纸篓里的笔记用到的附件、只存在 iCloud 里的笔记和刚放进来的文件都不会被清掉
  7. Mac：在编辑器外按 Command-Z 也能撤销当前笔记，连着按替换不会再替换自己刚写进去的文字，斜杠模板的占位文字跟着界面语言
  8. Mac：YouTube 视频在预览和导出的 HTML 里都能直接播放
  9. Mac：Magic PPT 里的 Mermaid 图正常画出来了，不再显示语法错误，导出 PDF 会等图都画好再打印
  10. Mac：思维导图里的公式和代码能正常显示，导出 PDF 时居中，也不再联网加载
  11. Mac：很长的笔记里在代码块下面打字不再变慢
  12. 编辑表格时 Tab 和回车在单元格之间移动
  13. 置顶会通过 iCloud 跟着笔记同步到其他设备
  14. 预览和幻灯片支持化学式，没有 $ 的笔记里 \( \) 和 \[ \] 也按公式显示，很宽的公式可以左右滚动
  15. 按 GitHub 写法的标题链接能跳到对应标题，饼图换成八种柔和的颜色，相邻扇区不会撞色
  16. 笔记列表的日期跟着系统的地区和 12 或 24 小时制
  17. 笔记里可以放视频和文件了，视频在预览和

detail.readme:
MiaoYan

A native Mac app for local Markdown notes

MiaoYan is 妙言 in Chinese, words beyond words.

English · 中文 · 繁體 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Deutsch · Français

## Features - **Local-first**: Notes are Markdown files in a folder you choose, with no data collection, and iCloud Drive or Nutstore can sync them across devices - **Focused**: Folders, notes, and editor in three columns, with dark mode and no plugin system to maintain - **Native**: Built with Swift 6, lighter than web wrappers, with 60fps scroll sync in split preview - **Capable**: Wikilinks, LaTeX, Mermaid, version history, auto-formatting, and PPT presentations built in - **Portable**: The iPhone and iPad apps are on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/miaoyan/id6759252269), one purchase covers them and the Mac, and they open the same iCloud Drive folder, so you can keep writing on your phone and tablet, share a note as an image, or start one from a widget, Siri or Shortcuts ## Installation Get it on the App Store, one purchase for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with automatic updates: The open-source Mac app is also available through Homebrew (`brew install --cask miaoyan`) or [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan/releases/latest) (macOS 12.0+). ## Sync with Nutstore or Other Cloud Drives MiaoYan does not sign in to WebDAV or cloud-drive accounts and only reads and writes the Markdown folder you choose. After installing, create a `MiaoYan` folder in iCloud Drive, the local folder synced by the Nutstore desktop client, or any other location, then open Preferences (⌘,) and set it as the storage path. iCloud Drive, Nutstore, Dropbox, or another cloud-drive client handles cross-device sync. - **iPhone**: Pick the same cloud-drive folder in the system Files app, and if a provider does not offer a writable folder there, use iCloud Drive or make the folder available offline in that provider app first - **Folder check**: MiaoYan verifies read and write access before switching folders and keeps the current storage path if the folder is unavailable, without reporting the problem as a MiaoYan sync failure ## CLI ```bash # Install curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/MiaoYan/main/scripts/install.sh | bash # Usage miao open # Open note or folder miao new [text] # Create new note miao search <query> # Search notes in terminal miao list [folder] # List top-level folders, or the Markdown files in a folder miao cat <title|path> # Print note content miao update # Update CLI ``` ## Split Editor & Preview Mode Edit and preview sit side by side. Press `⌘\` to toggle split mode, or open Preferences, go to Editor, and set Default Mode to Split. Why not WYSIWYG like Typora? Pure Markdown editing is the whole point. Native WYSIWYG in Swift is heavy and fragile; split mode keeps writing focused while giving you instant, synchronized visual feedback. <img src="https://miaoyan.app/assets/shots/en-split-2400.webp" width="100%" alt="Split Editor & Preview Mode" /> ## Documentation - [Introduction to MiaoYan](Resources/Initial/Introduction%20to%20MiaoYan.md) - Usage guide and keyboard shortcuts - [Markdown Syntax Guide](Resources/Initial/MiaoYan%20Markdown%20Syntax%20Guide.md) - Syntax reference with math and diagrams - [PPT Presentation Mode](Resources/Initial/MiaoYan%20PPT.md) - Guide to creating presentations with `---` slide separators - [MiaoYan Agent Skill](skills/miaoyan) - Teach your agent MiaoYan syntax, attachments, PPT patterns, and CLI workflows Install the official skill with `npx skills add tw93/MiaoYan/skills/miaoyan -g`. ## Support - The most direct way to support me is getting [Mole for Mac](https://mole.fit), my paid Mac cleanup app - If MiaoYan helped you, give it a star, [share it](https://x.com/intent/tweet?url=https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan&text=MiaoYan%20-%20A%20native%20Mac%20app%20for%20local%20Markdown%20notes), or open an issue or PR - I have two cats, TangYuan and Coke. If MiaoYan brings you joy, you can feed them <a href="https://cats.tw93.fun?name=MiaoYan" target="_blank">canned food 🥩</a> These lovely people already did 🐱 <a href="https://cats.tw93.fun?name=MiaoYan"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/sponsors/main/assets/sponsors.svg" width="1000" loading="lazy" /></a> ## Acknowledgments - [glushchenko/fsnotes](https://github.com/glushchenko/fsnotes) - Initial project structure reference - [stackotter/swift-cmark-gfm](https://github.com/stackotter/swift-cmark-gfm) - Swift Markdown parser - [simonbs/Prettier](https://github.com/simonbs/Prettier) - Markdown formatting utilities - [raspu/Highlightr](https://github.com/raspu/Highlightr) - Syntax highlighting - [hakimel/reveal.js](https://github.com/hakimel/reveal.js) - PPT presentation framework ## License MIT License
detail.readme_zh:
妙言

轻灵的 Markdown 笔记本伴你写出妙言

English · 中文 · 繁體 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Deutsch · Français

## 特点 - **纯本地**：笔记就是你选定文件夹里的 Markdown 文件，不收集数据，要跨设备就交给 iCloud 云盘或坚果云同步 - **专注**：文件夹、笔记列表和编辑器分成三栏，带深色模式，不用维护插件 - **原生**：Swift 6 开发，比网页套壳更轻，分栏预览支持 60fps 双向滚动同步 - **称手**：双链、LaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图表、版本历史、自动排版和 PPT 演示都内置 - **随身**：iPhone 和 iPad 版在 [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/miaoyan/id6759252269) 上，和 Mac 一次购买通用，打开同一个 iCloud 云盘笔记文件夹，在手机和平板上也能接着写，还能把笔记分享成图片，用小组件、Siri 和快捷指令新建笔记 ## 安装使用 推荐从 App Store 安装，一次购买 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 都能用，自动更新： Mac 开源版也可以用 Homebrew（`brew install --cask miaoyan`）安装，或从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan/releases/latest) 下载（macOS 12.0+）。 ## 用坚果云或其他云盘同步妙言 妙言不会登录 WebDAV 或网盘账号，只读写你指定的 Markdown 文件夹，跨设备同步交给 iCloud 云盘、坚果云、Dropbox 等云盘客户端。安装后在 iCloud 云盘、坚果云桌面客户端的同步目录或其他位置创建 `MiaoYan` 文件夹，打开设置（⌘,）把存储位置指向它，就可以开始写了。 - **iPhone**：在系统“文件”App 中选择同一个云盘文件夹，云盘 App 没有提供可写文件夹的话，就用 iCloud 云盘，或先在云盘 App 里把这个文件夹设为离线可用再选 - **目录检查**：妙言会在切换目录前确认文件夹可读写，不可用时保留原路径，也不会把问题误报成妙言自己的云同步失败 ## 命令行工具 ```bash # 安装 curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/MiaoYan/main/scripts/install.sh | bash # 使用 miao open <标题|路径> # 打开笔记或文件夹 miao new <标题> [内容] # 创建新笔记 miao search <关键词> # 在终端搜索笔记 miao list [目录] # 列出一级目录，或列出指定目录下的 Markdown miao cat <标题|路径> # 输出笔记内容 miao update # 更新 CLI ``` ## 分栏编辑预览模式 编辑区和预览区并排显示，按 `⌘\` 切换分栏模式，或在设置的编辑器页把默认模式设为分栏。为什么不做 Typora 式所见即所得？我想让你一直看着 Markdown 原文写，用原生 Swift 做所见即所得很重，也难保证稳定，分栏模式能专心写字，旁边就是实时预览。 ## 使用指南 - [介绍妙言](Resources/Initial/介绍妙言.md) - 使用说明和快捷键 - [Markdown 语法指南](Resources/Initial/妙言%20Markdown%20语法指南.md) - 语法演示，含数学公式和图表 - [PPT 演示模式](Resources/Initial/妙言%20PPT.md) - 使用 `---` 分隔幻灯片的演示指南 - [妙言 Agent Skill](skills/miaoyan) - 让 Agent 掌握妙言语法、附件、PPT 与 CLI 使用方式 运行 `npx skills add tw93/MiaoYan/skills/miaoyan -g` 安装官方 Skill。 ## 支持 - 购买我做的 Mac 清理应用 [Mole for Mac](https://mole.fit)，是对我最直接的支持 - 如果你喜欢妙言，欢迎给它一个 Star，推荐给身边喜欢纯文本的朋友，[分享出去](https://x.com/intent/tweet?url=https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan&text=%E5%A6%99%E8%A8%80%20-%20%E8%BD%BB%E7%81%B5%E7%9A%84%20Markdown%20%E7%AC%94%E8%AE%B0%E6%9C%AC%E4%BC%B4%E4%BD%A0%E5%86%99%E5%87%BA%E5%A6%99%E8%A8%80)，或者提 issue 和 PR - 我有两只猫，汤圆和可乐，如果妙言让你开心，可以请她们吃罐头 🥩 这些可爱的朋友已经投喂过了 🐱 ## 致谢 - [glushchenko/fsnotes](https://github.com/glushchenko/fsnotes) - 项目初始结构参考 - [stackotter/swift-cmark-gfm](https://github.com/stackotter/swift-cmark-gfm) - Swift Markdown 解析器 - [simonbs/Prettier](https://github.com/simonbs/Prettier) - Markdown 格式化工具 - [raspu/Highlightr](https://github.com/raspu/Highlightr) - 语法高亮支持 - [hakimel/reveal.js](https://github.com/hakimel/reveal.js) - PPT 演示框架 ## 协议 MIT License
